title: Technologische Beschreibung und physiologische Bewertung eines hochaufgelösten Laserscanner- Scheinwerfersystems
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: The approach of a laser scanning headlamp for adaptive light functions includes six laser sources which are deviated on a micro mirror. The oscillation of that mirror generates an extended light distribution on a white light converter which is then projected on the road. This work describes that approach and presents methods to evaluate the homogeneity of headlamp light distributions.
